analyst.rationale: The upward purchase trend (118 vs 106) suggests strong organic demand. Given the merchant margin constraints and available stock, focusing on demand stimulation for merchants with higher capacity (Corner Supply) is the most efficient use of the budget.

science.rationale: The upward purchase trend indicates strong organic demand. Given the lack of a mature model and the high uncertainty regarding campaign lift, observing current performance is the most prudent approach.

review.rationale: The upward purchase trend and lack of mature model diagnostics support the proposal to observe current performance rather than initiating a campaign with uncertain economic lift.
